questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Let $A$ be a $3 \times 3$ invertible matrix with determinant $|A| = 2$ in [Matrices]. What is the integer value of $|\text{adj}(\text{adj}(A))|$?
questions.solution: For an $n \times n$ matrix, $|\text{adj}(\text{adj}(A))| = |A|^{(n-1)^2}$. For $n = 3$, $(3 - 1)^2 = 4$. Thus $|A|^4 = 2^4 = 16$.
questions.explanation: Derive using rigorous mathematical theorems in Matrices.
